whatsappMessage:
Hi Team BTS Disc Cafe & Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.4★ reviews with 450+ happy diners on West Boring Canal Road, but you currently lack a dedicated mobile website for online table bookings and menu discovery.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food gallery, aur signature menu items integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/btsdisc

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team BTS Disc Cafe & Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, and your prime location at Puspanjali Mall on West Boring Canal Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact food menu, actual interior photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
